title: Webhook replay under-credits one merchant's balance
summary: The webhook replay job that reports each merchant's net balance shows one merchant lower than the ledger, and payouts are held until it reconciles.
task: Report each merchant's net balance in cents, charges minus refunds, from the replayed webhook event log so the payout it feeds reconciles with the merchant's own ledger.

company.notes: Stripe bug-squash: reproduce from the failing oracle, follow the call path from an at-least-once webhook bus through the idempotency step, and make a targeted dedup fix without rewriting unrelated code.

expected_output:
=== Net balance (cents) by merchant ===
delta_foods: 8000
luna_labs: 5400
orbit_goods: 4500
pine_market: 8400
buggy_output:
=== Net balance (cents) by merchant ===
delta_foods: 8000
luna_labs: 5400
orbit_goods: 2000
pine_market: 8400

phase2.spec_patch: Finance also needs chargebacks folded in. A `dispute` event means the funds were pulled back from the merchant, so it must subtract its amount from that merchant's net balance, deduplicated by event_id the same way a redelivered charge is: a dispute that arrives more than once is still one dispute.
phase2.expected_output_v2:
=== Net balance (cents) by merchant ===
delta_foods: 4700
luna_labs: 400
orbit_goods: 4500
pine_market: 8400
